#include <bits/stdc++.h>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

void solve() {
    ll x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    
    ll best_a = 0, best_b = 1;
    double target = (double)x / y;
    double min_diff = 1e18;
    
    for (ll b = 1; b <= n; b++) {
        // Find the best a for this denominator b
        ll a = (x * b + y / 2) / y; // Round to nearest
        
        // Check floor and ceil to be safe
        vector<ll> candidates = {max(0LL, a - 1), a, a + 1};
        
        for (ll cand : candidates) {
            double frac = (double)cand / b;
            double diff = abs(frac - target);
            
            if (diff < min_diff || 
                (diff == min_diff && b < best_b) ||
                (diff == min_diff && b == best_b && cand < best_a)) {
                min_diff = diff;
                best_a = cand;
                best_b = b;
            }
        }
    }
    
    ll g = __gcd(best_a, best_b);
    cout << best_a / g << '/' << best_b / g << endl;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cout.tie(nullptr);
    
    ll test = 1;
    while (test--) solve();
    
    return 0;
}
